hub_record.review_note: Independent re-verification by Claude Sonnet 5 (read-only, local checks, no Docker/MCP delegation). nginx.conf: byte-for-byte diff against .run/culture_next7_release_root_20261013/package-v2/quiz-2026.10.13-culture-e437661/nginx.conf confirms the only delta is one explanatory comment plus `etag off;`/`if_modified_since off;` immediately before Cache-Control; every proxy route (/v1/reports, /v1/, health checks, version.json, SPA fallback), security header, and client_max_body_size limit is untouched. Locally recomputed sha256 of both files matches the baseline/fixed config_sha256 values recorded in regression.json exactly (ef294b23... and e9add812...), independently confirming the evidence was produced from these exact files, not substituted. check_cache_validators.py correctly reproduces the bug class: two equal-length, mtime-zero fixtures (version.json, main.dart.js) are rewritten to new equal-length content, and under the baseline config all three conditional-header combinations (If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since, both) return false 304 with empty bodies -- a real repro of stale-ETag/mtime collision, not a synthetic assertion. Under the fixed config the same three combinations all return 200 with the updated bytes, and ETag is absent while the five expected security/cache headers are still asserted present in every response. The script is appropriately isolated: --pull=never, --network=none for syntax check, read-only root with tmpfs /tmp, loopback-only publish, named container removed in a finally block, image inspected but never pulled/replaced. production_before/production_after in regression.json show an unchanged image digest, ready/available counts and deployment_generation (45), supporting the claim that no production rollout occurred. Scope is clean: git status shows only next/infra/production/ (nginx.conf, README.md, Dockerfile.cache-hotfix, check_cache_validators.py) and docs/rewrite-agents/tasks/CACHE_VALIDATORS_20261013/ as new/untracked, no application, content, or database files touched. harness-v1-error.txt is a plausible, consistent record of a prior unescaped-newline Python syntax failure, not a masked real failure. Dockerfile.cache-hotfix is a minimal FROM-existing-base + COPY-config-only layer, consistent with the configuration-only release proposal (new image digest/Helm revision, unchanged application build identity) -- reviewed only as a proposal, not executed. Limitations of my review: I did not run Docker or the script myself (read-only mandate), did not inspect the live production cluster, and did not review root task task-1d3c57e523074692953b8e4c38c74714 (release preparation), per instructions. Verdict: accept -- the nginx diff matches the stated intent exactly, and the regression test credibly reproduces false 304s pre-fix and correct 200s with updated bytes post-fix for both conditional headers on two independent equal-length/mtime-collision assets.

review_text:
Review complete. I independently verified and recorded an **accept** verdict for task-3bad1bb3966d4b77978781b0e1b191fd (team-3757c89ef50e4ffa8ae5e721b711ce4b), now in state `ACCEPTED`.

**What I checked:**
- `next/infra/production/nginx.conf` vs the original package nginx.conf: byte-diff shows exactly one comment + `etag off;` + `if_modified_since off;` added, nothing else changed (routes, headers, limits all identical). Recomputed SHA-256 of both files locally and they match the `config_sha256` values baked into `regression.json` (`ef294b23...` baseline, `e9add812...` fixed), so the evidence wasn't produced from substituted files.
- `check_cache_validators.py`: genuinely reproduces the bug — two equal-length, mtime-zeroed fixtures (`version.json`, `main.dart.js`) get rewritten to new equal-length content; under the old config all three conditional-header combos (If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since / both) return a false `304` with empty body; under the fixed config the same three combos return `200` with the new bytes. Security/cache headers are asserted present in every response; container is isolated (`--pull=never`, `--network=none` for syntax check, read-only mount, tmpfs, loopback-only, cleaned up in `finally`).
- `regression.json`'s `production_before`/`production_after` show an unchanged image digest and deployment generation — consistent with "no release occurred."
- Scope: only files under `next/infra/production/` and the task's own handoff doc dir are new/untracked — no content/DB/application changes.
- `Dockerfile.cache-hotfix` (config-only release proposal) is a minimal `FROM <verified base> + COPY nginx.conf` layer — reasonable as a proposal; I did not execute or endorse running the release itself.

**Limits of my review:** read-only, no Docker/tests run by me, didn't touch the live cluster, and per instructions I did not review the broader root task task-1d3c57e523074692953b8e4c38c74714 (release prep) — that remains open for later.
